This app shows the StrideBoard website and sends your daily step totals to it automatically. Just log in: there is nothing to copy or paste.
3. Step access: StrideBoard only reads your daily step count
Allow step access · السماح بالوصول إلى الخطوات

What StrideBoard reads: only your daily step count, from Health Connect. Nothing else: no location, heart rate, sleep or workouts.

Why: to show your daily progress, score the leaderboards and reward your progress. If you also allow background access, your steps keep syncing while the app is closed, so the leaderboards stay up to date.

Your step data is never sold to anyone and never used for advertising. Use of information received from Health Connect follows the Health Connect Permissions Policy, including the Limited Use requirements.

ما الذي يقرؤه StrideBoard: عدد خطواتك اليومي فقط من Health Connect. لا شيء غير ذلك: لا الموقع ولا نبضات القلب ولا النوم ولا التمارين.

لماذا: لعرض تقدّمك اليومي، وحساب ترتيب لوحات المتصدرين، ومكافأتك على تقدّمك. وإذا سمحت أيضًا بالوصول في الخلفية، تستمر مزامنة خطواتك والتطبيق مغلق، لتبقى لوحات المتصدرين محدّثة.

لن تُباع بيانات خطواتك لأي جهة أبدًا، ولن تُستخدم للإعلانات أبدًا. يلتزم استخدام المعلومات الواردة من Health Connect بسياسة أذونات Health Connect، بما في ذلك متطلبات الاستخدام المحدود.
Disconnect and clear this phone · فصل ومسح هذا الهاتف
Disconnect this phone? · فصل هذا الهاتف؟

StrideBoard will stop reading your steps, remove its Health Connect permission, and erase everything it saved on this phone (your account link and sync history). Your StrideBoard account and the steps already sent stay as they are: to delete those, use Settings → Your data and privacy on the website.

— — —

سيتوقف StrideBoard عن قراءة خطواتك، ويزيل إذن Health Connect، ويمسح كل ما حفظه على هذا الهاتف (ربط حسابك وسجل المزامنة). يبقى حسابك في StrideBoard والخطوات المرسلة سابقًا كما هي: لحذفها، استخدم الإعدادات ← بياناتك وخصوصيتك على الموقع.
This phone is disconnected and cleared. · تم فصل هذا الهاتف ومسحه.

StrideBoard reads only one kind of health data: your total number of steps for each of the last 7 days, from Health Connect (so days spent without internet still count once you are back online).

It sends those daily totals, with the date and your personal StrideBoard token, to your school's StrideBoard website, where they appear on your dashboard and the leaderboards.

It does not read your location, heart rate, sleep, workouts or any other health data, and it never writes anything into Health Connect. Your data is never sold, never used for advertising and not shared with anyone outside the StrideBoard website. Use of information received from Health Connect follows the Health Connect Permissions Policy, including the Limited Use requirements. With background access, steps sync while the app is closed so leaderboards stay up to date.

You can stop it at any time: open Health Connect → App permissions → StrideBoard and turn Steps off, or uninstall the app. Your token is stored encrypted on this phone. To download or delete the data already sent, open StrideBoard → Settings → Your data and privacy.
